items.name: Hearty Soup
items.summary: Early-game healing soup that anyone can craft
items.description: Hearty Soup heals 2 hearts of health and can be crafted by anyone. It's an excellent early-game healing option before Healers can make bandages.

items.name: Bandage
items.summary: Primary healing item used by Healers
items.description: Bandages are the primary healing item in CivLabs. Healers use them to heal themselves, heal other players, and revive downed players through a minigame. Healing amount scales with Healer level.

items.name: Blaze Rod
items.summary: Craftable brewing ingredient for Master Healers
items.description: Blaze Rods can be crafted by Master (level 4) Healers, enabling potion brewing without needing to find a Nether Fortress.

items.name: Nether Wart

items.name: Coal Ore
items.summary: Common ore found in most biomes at Y 0-100
items.description:
Coal Ore is the most common ore, found between Y 0 and Y 100 in most biomes. Best Y-level for mining is Y 50.

**Generation Rates:**
- Tier 3 (24 veins/chunk): Most biomes including Flatlands, Forests, Mountains, Desert, Beach, Ocean, Mushroom Island, Cherry Forest
- Tier 4 (38 veins/chunk): Lush Cave, Cave (with Large Veins)
- Tier 5 (45 veins/chunk): Volcano (with Large Veins)

**Large Coal Ore Veins:**
- Y-Range: 0 to 250
- Coverage: 10% (very common)
- Indicator Block: **Andesite**
- Spawns in: Volcano, Lush Cave, Cave

When you see Andesite formations between Y 0-250 in these biomes, mine into them to find coal ore deposits.

items.name: Deepslate Coal Ore
items.summary: Coal ore found in deepslate layers
items.description: Deepslate Coal Ore generates in the deepslate layer below Y 0. It has the same drop as regular coal ore but takes longer to mine.

items.name: Coal
items.summary: Fuel source dropped from coal ore
items.description: Coal is obtained by mining Coal Ore. It is primarily used as fuel for furnaces and smelting operations. One coal smelts 8 items.

items.name: Copper Ore
items.summary: Common ore found at Y -16 to 112 in most biomes
items.description:
Copper Ore generates between Y -16 and Y 112 in most biomes. Best Y-level for mining is Y 48.

**Generation Rates:**
- Tier 3 (22 veins/chunk): Most biomes
- **No Copper**: Hot Flatland, Lush Cave, Cave

**Large Copper Ore Veins:**
- Y-Range: 0 to 64
- Coverage: 9% (common)
- Indicator Block: **Granite**
- Currently not assigned to any biome (configured but disabled)

Copper is found in most biomes except Hot Flatland and cave biomes.

items.name: Deepslate Copper Ore
items.summary: Copper ore found in deepslate layers
items.description: Deepslate Copper Ore generates in the deepslate layer below Y 0. It drops Raw Copper when mined.

items.name: Raw Copper
items.summary: Unprocessed copper from mining copper ore
items.description: Raw Copper is dropped when mining Copper Ore. It can be smelted into Copper Ingots in a furnace.

items.name: Copper Ingot
items.summary: Smelted copper used for tools and building
items.description: Copper Ingots are obtained by smelting Raw Copper. Used in various crafting recipes.

items.name: Iron Ore
items.summary: Essential ore with best rates in mountains and caves
items.description:
Iron Ore is one of the most important resources. It generates across multiple height bands with concentration peaking around Y 16.

**Generation Rates:**
- Tier 2 (43 veins/chunk): Flatlands, Forests, Desert, Beach, Ocean, Mushroom Island, Volcano
- Tier 3 (59 veins/chunk): All Mountains, Polar, Lush Cave, Cave

**Large Iron Ore Veins:**
- Y-Range: -50 to 0
- Coverage: 9% (common)
- Indicator Block: **Tuff**
- Contains: Deepslate Iron Ore + Raw Iron Blocks
- Spawns in: **Beach only**

When mining in Beach biomes, look for Tuff formations between Y -50 to 0. These indicate large iron deposits that may contain Raw Iron Blocks.

items.name: Deepslate Iron Ore
items.summary: Iron ore found in deepslate layers
items.description: Deepslate Iron Ore generates in the deepslate layer below Y 0. Found in large iron veins indicated by Tuff in Beach biomes. It drops Raw Iron when mined.

items.name: Raw Iron
items.summary: Unprocessed iron from mining iron ore
items.description: Raw Iron is dropped when mining Iron Ore. It can be smelted into Iron Ingots in a furnace. Large iron veins in Beach biomes may also contain Raw Iron Blocks.

items.name: Iron Ingot
items.summary: Smelted iron for crafting and smithing
items.description: Iron Ingots are obtained by smelting Raw Iron. Used in various crafting recipes.

items.name: Gold Ore
items.summary: Rare ore found only in hot biomes
items.description:
Gold Ore has very limited distribution, only generating in hot climate biomes. Best Y-level for mining is Y -16.

**Generation Rates:**
- **No Gold**: Most biomes (Temperate, Warm, Cold, Polar, Beach, Ocean, Caves, Mushroom Island, Cherry Forest, Volcano)
- Tier 2 Full (11 veins/chunk): Hot Flatland, Hot Forest
- Tier 2+4 (12 veins/chunk): Desert, Hot Mountain (with Large Veins)

**Large Gold Ore Veins:**
- Y-Range: 32 to 96
- Coverage: 7% (uncommon)
- Indicator Block: **Granite**
- Contains: Gold Ore + Deepslate Gold Ore + **Raw Gold Blocks**
- Spawns in: Desert, Hot Mountain

For large veins, best Y-level is Y 64. Look for Granite formations in Desert or Hot Mountain biomes.

items.name: Deepslate Gold Ore
items.summary: Gold ore found in deepslate layers
items.description: Deepslate Gold Ore generates in the deepslate layer below Y 0 in hot biomes. Also found in large gold veins in Desert and Hot Mountain biomes.

items.name: Raw Gold
items.summary: Unprocessed gold from mining gold ore
items.description: Raw Gold is dropped when mining Gold Ore. It can be smelted into Gold Ingots in a furnace. Large gold veins in Desert and Hot Mountain may contain Raw Gold Blocks.

items.name: Gold Ingot
items.summary: Smelted gold for crafting and smithing
items.description: Gold Ingots are obtained by smelting Raw Gold. Used in various crafting recipes.

items.name: Redstone Ore
items.description:
Redstone Ore has very limited distribution, only generating in temperate climate biomes. Best Y-level for mining is Y -56.

**Generation Rates:**
- **No Redstone**: Most biomes (Warm, Hot, Cold, Polar, Desert, Beach, Ocean, Caves, Mushroom Island, Cherry Forest, Volcano)
- Tier 2 (23 veins/chunk): Temperate Flatland, Temperate Forest
- Tier 4 (33 veins/chunk): Temperate Mountain (with Large Veins)

**Large Redstone Ore Veins:**
- Y-Range: -64 to 16
- Coverage: 5.5%
- Indicator Block: **Blackstone**
- Contains: Deepslate Redstone Ore
- Spawns in: Temperate Mountain only

Look for Blackstone formations in Temperate Mountain biomes between Y -64 and Y 16.

items.name: Deepslate Redstone Ore
items.description: Deepslate Redstone Ore generates in the deepslate layer in temperate biomes. Found in large veins indicated by Blackstone in Temperate Mountain.

items.name: Redstone Dust
items.description: Redstone Dust is obtained by mining Redstone Ore. It drops 4-5 dust per ore block. Used for creating redstone circuits, brewing, and various crafting recipes.

items.name: Lapis Lazuli Ore
items.description:
Lapis Lazuli Ore has very limited distribution, only generating in warm climate biomes. Best Y-level for mining is Y 0.

**Generation Rates:**
- **No Lapis**: Most biomes (Temperate, Hot, Cold, Polar, Desert, Beach, Ocean, Caves, Mushroom Island, Cherry Forest, Volcano)
- Tier 2 (8 veins/chunk): Warm Flatland, Warm Forest
- Tier 4 (30 veins/chunk): Warm Mountain (with Large Veins)

**Large Lapis Ore Veins:**
- Y-Range: -32 to 32
- Coverage: 4.5%
- Indicator Block: **Calcite**
- Spawns in: Warm Mountain only

Look for Calcite formations in Warm Mountain biomes between Y -32 and Y 32.

items.name: Deepslate Lapis Lazuli Ore
items.description: Deepslate Lapis Lazuli Ore generates in the deepslate layer in warm biomes. Found in large veins indicated by Calcite in Warm Mountain.

items.name: Lapis Lazuli
items.description: Lapis Lazuli is obtained by mining Lapis Lazuli Ore. It drops 4-9 lapis per ore block. Required for enchanting items at an enchantment table and used as blue dye.

metadata.dropsFrom: Lapis Lazuli Ore, Deepslate Lapis Lazuli Ore

items.name: Diamond Ore
items.summary: Precious ore with higher rates in mountains and special biomes
items.description:
Diamond Ore is the most valuable standard ore. It generates in three height bands with concentration highest in the lowest band (Y -64 to -44). Best Y-level for mining is Y -54 to -59.

**Generation Rates:**
- Tier 1 (6 veins/chunk): Flatlands, Forests, Beach, Ocean, Caves, Mushroom Island
- Tier 2 (9 veins/chunk): All Mountains, Desert, Polar, Cherry Forest, Volcano

**Large Diamond Ore Veins:**
- Y-Range: -64 to 100
- Coverage: 2% (extremely rare)
- Indicator Block: **Obsidian**
- Spawns in: **Volcano only**

Volcano biome is the best for diamond mining - it has Tier 2 rates AND is the only biome with large diamond veins. Look for Obsidian formations underground.

items.name: Deepslate Diamond Ore
items.description: Deepslate Diamond Ore generates in the deepslate layer below Y 0. This is where most diamonds are found since the best Y-level is around -54 to -59.

items.name: Diamond
items.description: Diamonds are obtained by mining Diamond Ore with an iron pickaxe or better. They are used to craft Diamond Plates for the highest-tier standard equipment before netherite.

items.name: Emerald Ore
items.summary: Found only in cold biomes, extremely abundant in mountains
items.description:
Emerald Ore has very limited but potentially abundant generation in cold climate biomes. Best Y-level for mining is Y 64-120.

**Generation Rates:**
- **No Emerald**: Most biomes (Temperate, Warm, Hot, Desert, Beach, Ocean, Caves, Mushroom Island, Cherry Forest, Volcano)
- Tier 2 (4 veins/chunk): Cold Flatland, Cold Forest
- Tier 4 (303 veins/chunk!): Cold Mountain, Polar (with Large Veins)

**Large Emerald Ore Veins:**
- Y-Range: 0 to 200
- Coverage: 3.5%
- Indicator Block: **Diorite**
- Spawns in: Cold Mountain, Polar

Cold Mountain and Polar biomes have the highest emerald concentration in the game at 303 veins per chunk! Look for Diorite formations at higher elevations.

items.name: Deepslate Emerald Ore
items.description: Deepslate Emerald Ore generates in the deepslate layer in cold biomes. Less common than stone-level emerald ore since emeralds spawn best at higher Y-levels.

items.name: Emerald
items.summary: Gem used for trading and XP transfer
items.description: Emeralds are obtained by mining Emerald Ore with an iron pickaxe or better. They are used in the Emerald Infusion system to transfer Class XP between players.

items.name: Netherite Ingot
items.description: Netherite Ingots are the most valuable crafting material. Used in the highest tier armor and tool crafting by Grandmaster Blacksmiths.
